title: wildfire_signal
description: A signal emitted by a wildfire-watch drone to be ingested by the Sapphire signal_logger (services/alpha/src/signal_logger.py). Designed to be JSONL-appendable to data/wildfire_signals.jsonl following the same pattern as data/trading_signals.jsonl.

schema_version.description: Semver of this schema. Bump on breaking change.

signal_id.description: Stable UUIDv4 generated on the drone at signal-emit time. Idempotency key for the signal_logger receiver.

drone_id.description: wildfire-watch unit identifier, e.g. wfw-unit01. Tracks back to airframe + RPIC + insurance record.

zone_id.description: GeoJSON zone identifier from missions/zones/ — the zone the drone was patrolling at emit time.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of signal emit. Drone clock disciplined by GPS.

alt_agl_m.description: Altitude above ground level in meters (barometer + rangefinder fusion).

alt_msl_m.description: Altitude above mean sea level in meters. Computed from GPS + ellipsoid model.

heading_deg.description: Drone heading at emit time, deg true.

target_coords.description: Estimated coordinates of the detected target (smoke plume center, animal, etc.). May differ from drone coords by hundreds of meters.

signal_type.description: Coarse signal category. Multimodal fusion gate output. signal_type=fire requires both RGB and thermal positives.

signal_subtype.description: Free-form subtype, e.g. wildlife/megadetector_animal, smoke/persistent_plume, anomaly/unusual_human_activity.

confidence.description: Fused multimodal confidence. Edge gating threshold typically 0.65; auto-loiter at >=0.85.

frame_uris.description: GCS or local URIs to evidence frames (RGB + thermal). Pattern: gs://wildfire-watch-evidence/{zone_id}/{date}/{signal_id}/frame_*.{jpg,png,tiff}

thermal_frame_uris.description: Subset of frame_uris that are radiometric thermal (16-bit TIFF preferred for retraining).

video_clip_uri.description: Optional ~30-second clip surrounding the emit (10s before + 20s after).

model_outputs.description: Raw model outputs for debugging and retraining triage.

environment.description: NOAA / drone-sensor environmental context at emit time.

risk_score.description: Composite risk = f(confidence, signal_type, fire_weather_index, distance to wildland-urban interface, persistence). 0 = none, 100 = critical.

recommended_action.description: Drone's recommendation. Ground station decides actual fan-out (e.g. notify_fire_dept may be gated by 2-of-N quorum from peer drones).

consensus.description: Multi-drone / multi-model consensus state. Empty for single-drone MVP.

tfr_active.description: FAA TFR currently over emit coords (must be false for autonomous emit).
